728-7084-7396.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3641-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-6709-7737.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

779-2178-2835-4050-7409.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four land cards in your graveyard.
779-2178-2835-4050-7409.description:
Activate Lluwen by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}, tapping it and discarding Dakmor Salvage, creating a 1/1 Wurm creature token for each land card in your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Wurms, adding {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}.
When the Wurms die, Fecundity and Lluwen trigger five times each.
Resolve all Lluwen triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the first Fecundity trigger, instead choosing to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Fecundity triggers, drawing as many cards as desired.
Repeat.
779-2178-2835-4050-7409.notes: As you mill cards, inevitably more lands will end up in your graveyard, meaning you'll make more tokens over time.

1169-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

997-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
997-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1978-7013-7170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-7013-7170.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Living Brain.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1418-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve both Redcap Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

6738-6791-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
6738-6791-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1874-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

862-5220-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

972-3542-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-3542-5913.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk and the Palinchron token.
When the Pinnacle Monk and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-3542-5913.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Pinnacle Monk instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

339-677-1753-2292.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-4359-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1850-2573-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2573-5413.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1274-1939-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1939-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

880-3875-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4374-5663-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability and Guie of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Aethergeode Miner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2028-4050--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2028-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Hexavus' second ability by paying {1} and removing the -1/-1 counter from the persist creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hexavus.
Repeat.

1479-3703-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

526-581-2232-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonartifact creature token.
Your life total is no greater than 12.
526-581-2232-4050.description:
Cast Death's Shadow by paying {B}.
When Death's Shadow enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating a copy of any nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Death's Shadow to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2713-3076-4474-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
2713-3076-4474-4639.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1335-3129-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-3129-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

819-869-1980-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1680-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
1680-3670-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Runed Stalactite, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

823-2034-2577-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 4.
You control an additional Zombie.
823-2034-2577-4740.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Defiler of Flesh trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Defiler of Flesh trigger, giving target creature +1/+1 and menace until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

907-1479-3875.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-3875.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2021-2060-3062-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

719-1486-3337-4284.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of other Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1922.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Blur.
147-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Blur, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Blur, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1168-1479-2232.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nonartifact land.
You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
1168-1479-2232.description:
Play a nonartifact land card.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama of the East Tree, Toggo, and Cloudstone Curio.
In response, activate any untapped lands you control by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning another nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land you returned from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning a nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating a Rock artifact token.
When the Rock token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, causing you to put a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Stop the loop by choosing not to use a Kodama of the East Tree or a Cloudstone Curio ability.
Resolve all Toggo triggers, creating any number of Rock tokens.
Kodama of the East Tree triggers once for each Rock token created; decline to use these abilities.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

914-4050-5222.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4050-5222.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1335-2744-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2744-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
If necessary, activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
